transcript.text: Hi everyone, Mara here. I'm ready to start the daily build meeting for the Stage 4 musical number. We've got the draft build package in hand — it calls for a 700 kg scenic platform, a red fabric backdrop, and a west-side camera entrance. Before I can issue the final build package and let the scenic crew begin construction, I need to collect signoffs and any required changes from each department. Let's hear from each of you — what do you need to flag or approve?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical change before we proceed. I received the stage engineer's revised floor-load map after the draft package circulated. The planned 700 kg platform cannot be concentrated on one area as currently specified. The approved alternative is three separate platforms with load spreaders, each carrying no more than 400 kg. I haven't uploaded the revised map to the build packet yet, but this change needs to be reflected in the final package before construction begins.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a materials issue on the fabric backdrop. I confirmed with our fabric supplier this morning that the only available backdrop material with the required flame-retardant certification is 180 meters of Slate Gray FR-7. The red fabric specified in the draft package has no current certification, so it can't pass fire safety. I'm still waiting on the purchase order before I can enter the confirmation in the materials log, but the backdrop color will need to change from red to Slate Gray in the final build package.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical change on the camera entrance. My camera test after blocking showed that the crane needs a clear west-to-east lane 2.4 meters wide, which means the scenic entrance must be on the east side, not the west side as called for in the current draft. This test note is in my camera report but hasn't been added to the scenic drawings yet, so the final build package needs to reflect an east-side entrance instead.
transcript.speaker: A4
